result.instructions: Tools for Stibee, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many active subscribers does our newsletter address book have?"; "Add this customer to the 'Trial users' group in our address book."; "Which of our last 5 emails had the best open rate?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Stibee data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run stibee_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run stibee_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run stibee_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. stibee_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: stibee_list_address_books
tools.title: List address books
tools.description: List the address books (lists) of the workspace. Enterprise plan only. Stibee: GET /lists.

tools.name: stibee_get_address_book
tools.title: Get an address book
tools.description: Get one address book with its name, sender name and settings. Enterprise plan only. Stibee: GET /lists/{id}.

list_id.description: Address book id (the list id in Stibee).

tools.name: stibee_list_subscribers
tools.title: List subscribers
tools.description: List subscribers of an address book, with status, custom fields, group ids and dates. Rate limit 100 calls per minute. Stibee: GET /lists/{id}/subscribers.

list_id.description: Address book id (the list id in Stibee).

statuses.description: Comma-separated subscriber statuses: subscribed, unsubscribed, ready, archived. Example: subscribed,unsubscribed

tools.name: stibee_count_subscribers
tools.title: Count subscribers
tools.description: Count the subscribers of an address book, optionally by status. Stibee: GET /lists/{id}/subscribers/count.

list_id.description: Address book id (the list id in Stibee).

statuses.description: Comma-separated subscriber statuses: subscribed, unsubscribed, ready, archived. Example: subscribed,unsubscribed

tools.name: stibee_get_subscriber_stats
tools.title: Get subscriber email stats
tools.description: Count how one subscriber reacted to up to 30 emails: sent, opened, clicked, unsubscribed, bounced. Rate limit 100 calls per minute. Stibee: POST /lists/{id}/subscribers/stats/query.

list_id.description: Address book id (the list id in Stibee).

subscriber.description: Subscriber email address (one subscriber per call).

tools.name: stibee_add_subscriber
tools.title: Add a subscriber
tools.description: Add one subscriber to an address book. Set update_enabled to true to update an existing subscriber instead of failing. Stibee: POST /lists/{id}/subscribers.

list_id.description: Address book id (the list id in Stibee).

fields.description: Custom field values by field name. Only fields that exist on the address book are accepted.

update_enabled.description: true: update fields of an existing subscriber. Default false.

tools.name: stibee_add_subscribers_batch
tools.title: Add subscribers in bulk
tools.description: Add up to 1000 subscribers in one call. Returns lists of created, updated and failed emails. Rate limit 10 calls per minute. Stibee: POST /lists/{id}/subscribers/batch.

list_id.description: Address book id (the list id in Stibee).

fields.description: Custom field values by field name. Only fields that exist on the address book are accepted.

update_enabled.description: true: update existing subscribers. Default false.

tools.name: stibee_update_subscriber_fields
tools.title: Update subscriber fields
tools.description: Set custom field values of an existing subscriber. Only custom fields are changed here. Stibee: PUT /lists/{id}/subscribers/{email}.

list_id.description: Address book id (the list id in Stibee).

fields.description: Custom field values by field name. Only fields that exist on the address book are accepted.

tools.name: stibee_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List the subscriber groups of an address book. Pro plan and up. Stibee: GET /lists/{id}/groups.

list_id.description: Address book id (the list id in Stibee).

tools.name: stibee_assign_subscriber_to_group
tools.title: Add a subscriber to a group
tools.description: Add an existing subscriber to a group. Fails if the subscriber is already in the group. Stibee: POST /lists/{id}/groups/{groupId}/assign.

list_id.description: Address book id (the list id in Stibee).

annotations.title: Add a subscriber to a group

tools.name: stibee_release_subscriber_from_group
tools.title: Remove a subscriber from a group
tools.description: Remove a subscriber from a group. The subscriber stays in the address book. Stibee: POST /lists/{id}/groups/{groupId}/release.

list_id.description: Address book id (the list id in Stibee).

annotations.title: Remove a subscriber from a group

tools.name: stibee_list_emails
tools.title: List emails
tools.description: List emails of the workspace, filtered by address book, status, type and send time. Pro plan and up. Stibee: GET /emails.

listId.description: Only emails of this address book.

statuses.description: Comma-separated status names, for example SENT,WRITING.

types.description: Comma-separated type names, for example NORMAL,AB_TEST.

sentAfter.description: Only emails sent after this time. Use with sentBefore or alone.

sentBefore.description: Only emails sent at or before this time. Needs sentAfter.

tools.name: stibee_get_email
tools.title: Get an email
tools.description: Get one email with its subject, sender, status and send time. Pro plan and up. Stibee: GET /emails/{id}.

tools.name: stibee_get_email_stats
tools.title: Get email open and click rates
tools.description: Get open rate and click rate for up to 10 emails in one call. Rate limit 100 calls per minute. Pro plan and up. Stibee: GET /emails/stats.

annotations.title: Get email open and click rates

tools.name: stibee_get_email_logs
tools.title: Get email activity log
tools.description: List what subscribers did with one email: delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed. Pro plan and up. Stibee: GET /emails/{id}/logs.

actions.description: Comma-separated actions: P delivered, O opened, C clicked, D unsubscribed, B hard bounce, F soft bounce.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Stibee
prompts.description: What you can do with Stibee here, with example requests to try.
